purpose: Teach: まとっ/ゆるやか/すえ/這い/とどまり/取り除い/くわしく/やしない

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店全体が落ち着いた空気をまとってるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you've created such a calm atmosphere throughout the whole shop.
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle smile in the voice. Noticing something real that Aoi has done. Slow, appreciative pace. No performance—just genuine.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゆるやかな会話を楽しんでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customers really seem to be enjoying these quiet conversations, don't they?
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful reflection. Looking around the space. Pacing that lets the observation breathe. A little wonder underneath—noticing something she didn't fully expect.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お話のすえに、お客様、また来ますって仰ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And one person said they'd definitely come back. That matters, you know.
lines.style: Quiet conviction beneath the warmth. Slight emphasis on the "come back"—the concrete proof of what Aoi's created. Gentle but sure.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、子犬が床を這いずる写真を見せて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer showed me a photo of their puppy crawling around. Made my day, honestly.
lines.style: Soft brightness. The detail—the specific puppy, the crawling—matters. Small smile audible. Not gushing, just genuinely delighted by the small kindness of being let in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店にもう少しとどまりたいってお客様が仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And someone mentioned they wanted to stay in the shop a little longer. They felt that.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Saying it like she's confirming something she suspected. Slow pace. The "they felt that" lands with gentle weight.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、テーブルのシミを取り除いてピカピカにしたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You even made that table spot disappear. It's gleaming now.
lines.style: Light noticing-of-details tone. Slight warmth—she sees the small care. Matter-of-fact but affectionate. Not praising theatrically, just acknowledging.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にメニューをくわしくご説明しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: You should take time to really walk them through the menu—let them understand what makes each choice special.
lines.style: Gentle guidance, not directive. Speaking like she's offering a thought Aoi might already have. Warm underneath the suggestion. Conversational pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の利益はやしないに回さないとね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And we should think about putting some of the profits back into the shop when we can. It matters.
lines.style: Practical, quiet sincerity. Not lecturing—more like thinking aloud together. Slight weight on "matters." The kind of care that doesn't need to be loud.
